query: What was the position of Jean Baptiste Androuet du Cerceau under the man who was King of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth from 1573 to 1575?

pipeline_result.response: Jean Baptiste Androuet du Cerceau, a French Jesuit priest and diplomat, served as the Cardinal-Archbishop of Paris from 1569 until his death in 1582. He was appointed by King Henry II of France to serve as the Archbishop of Paris, but he did not hold this position for long due to his close relationship with King Sigismund III Vasa and his desire to maintain a strong alliance with Poland.
